name: A duration is unknown unless both ends are known
why: A ticket nobody has resolved has no resolution time. Not zero, and not the time since it was opened — unknown. An implementation that read the missing end as the epoch would report a duration in decades, and one that read it as zero would report every open ticket as resolved instantly, which is worse because it looks like a good number.

cases.why: Fractional, because a datetime carries a time. Two and a half days is two and a half days, not two and not three.
The end not set. This is the whole file: an open ticket has an unknown resolution time.
And the start not set, so neither end is privileged.
A blank DATE is not a zero the way a blank number is. There is no sensible zero for a date, and inventing one would make this read as decades rather than as unknown.
Backwards is negative rather than an error. A record whose dates were entered the wrong way round should show an obviously wrong figure, not a plausible one.
An unknown duration spreads through the arithmetic built on it, exactly like a division by zero.
A plain DATE names a whole day, so the difference between two of them is a whole number of days.

The two ends may DISAGREE about their type, because nothing stops them: a duration argument is checked one at a time, so a date at one end and a datetime at the other passes `cordango check`. It has to therefore produce an application that compiles, and for a while it did not — the emitted call matched neither same-typed overload and the generated project failed at `dotnet build` with CS1503, which the author never saw because check had already said yes.
The bare date is the instant its day begins in UTC, so the time of day on the other end survives. Rounding the datetime down to a date instead would answer 0 here and call it agreement.
And the other way round, so neither end is the privileged one. Six hours into the first day leaves six hours less than the three whole days.
A mixed pair is still a duration, so a missing end still makes it unknown rather than dating the gap from midnight of year one.
